original_test_intent: Validate eight chip-temperature channels represented by TEMP_LP1~8_Chip against the approved LP platform specification across complete IB/OOB SDR, Sensor List and BMC Web evidence.
original_method: The platform owner defines LP, enumerates the eight exact chip sensors, binds each to a physical board/device instance and sensing source, and supplies state-qualified thermal limits before passive collection.
manual_activity: The LP/platform thermal owner defines the LP component class, maps all eight chip sensors to stable hardware identities and sensing sources, approves operating-state limits and reviews the complete evidence.
required_inputs: Authoritative expansion of LP and role of each LP1-LP8 component
Exact TEMP_LP1_Chip through TEMP_LP8_Chip naming syntax and populated count
Board revision, physical coordinate and stable device/serial/fabric identity per chip
Sensing source: on-die junction, internal/remote diode or nearby board probe
Units, scale, tolerance, sample interval, freshness and unavailable semantics
Ranges/thresholds by link/traffic/workload, power, airflow and ambient state
SDR entity/name/description plus Sensor List/Web mapping and same-target revisions
Secret-safe collectors and independent thermal/platform/BMC recovery
safety_requirements: Bind exact row 1892 and exclude HIB PEX evidence despite the shared code
Resolve eight exact chip names; do not use the literal tilde expression as proof
Do not infer LP meaning or equate chip and transceiver temperatures
Bind every channel to a stable physical/device identity and sensing source
Do not create workload/traffic, alter links/drivers/cooling/thresholds/BMC or clear logs
Stop on unknown LP identity, missing channel, stale/invalid reading, link/device fault or thermal event
agent_execution_scope: Verify row/variant, duplicate isolation, LP definition and eight-name expansion
Verify LP physical/device topology and same-target identity read-only
Collect complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List, eight exact chip results and BMC Web
Compare identity/value/state/freshness with passive link/load/power/airflow/SEL context
Perform no PEX substitution, workload, link/driver action, mutation, retry or verdict
engineer_actions: Define LP and approve eight-chip physical/stable-device map
Define chip sensor source and relationship to adjacent TRX channels
Provide operating-state-specific limits and unavailable rules
Review all eight chip channels and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A read-only starting point, but `TEMP_LP1~8_Chip` is combined notation rather than a proven exact name; SDR is truncated, credentials are exposed and IB/Sensor List/Web are incomplete.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Resolve eight owner-approved exact chip names and identities, then collect complete secret-safe IB/OOB SDR/Sensor List plus Web and passive operating-state context.

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES LP DEFINITION, EIGHT-CHIP IDENTITY MAP AND SENSOR SEMANTICS
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build an eight-row table from exact sensor string to LP role, board coordinate, stable device identity, sensing source and approved state-specific limit, then reconcile complete management views.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Eliminates ambiguity in both the LP component class and the placement of the `_Chip` suffix and prevents generic family output from proving eight devices.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: The preceding HIB PEX variant and following TRX family are distinct component/sensing domains and cannot substitute for LP chip temperatures.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: If a channel is a remote board diode rather than junction telemetry, its lag and limits differ; treating it as chip junction temperature can conceal a fast local overtemperature.

project_override_considerations: If exact names apply `_Chip` differently or some LP positions are unpopulated, the owner-approved inventory controls. Aliases require a uniqueness rule so one reading cannot count for multiple chips.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and both same-code rows with HIB evidence excluded
Approved LP definition, exact eight-name list and populated-position matrix
Eight physical/stable-device identities and sensing-source map
Units, scale, freshness and operating-state-qualified thermal criteria
Complete redacted IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List plus eight exact results
BMC Web, same-target proof and passive link/load/power/airflow/SEL context
No-workload/no-link/no-driver/no-cooling/no-threshold/no-reset/no-write/no-clear audit, statuses, hashes and engineer verdict

review_improvement: Separates this legitimate LP output target from the preceding row's contaminated field and adds the LP definition, stable chip identity and sensor-source semantics needed for valid limits.
independent_technical_reasoning: The label `LP` does not reveal whether the numbered devices are line processors, link processors or another platform-specific ASIC family, and `_Chip` does not establish junction versus remote-diode sensing. Both component identity and measurement point must be defined before eight readings can be compared to a thermal limit.
